items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Cripple Slim used to go down there with Sidney (they were buddies)

ctx.x: Yeah. He told her, "Oh, goodbye, little girl..." A nice Chinaman. It's a sentimental thing. You know, someone would go, "Yeah, that's a good Chinaman. He's ...(?). . .(?). . . The woman is weak, but he saw it and told her to go home..." [LAUGHS] So that's a legendary...

See, that one and "The Titanic." I used to sing "The Titanic." I can't sing it no more. The Titanic went down, and the Captain begs... Yeah, I forgot it all. "Slim, please save my wife and my daughter, the Titanic's gonna..." Slim jumped in the ocean and ...(?). . ., and swam faster than the sharks, he was dippin' and dodgin', savin' people all
